dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Yoohoo, greetings from Mualani, the shop owner! Welcome to one of the most renowned watersports shops in the whole of the People of the Springs! If you need anything, just leave a message! Hehe~"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Mualani, the shop owner, will be representing the People of the Springs in the upcoming Pilgrimage!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "When I return with a top ranking, I'll throw an awesome event for you guys — a huge watersports products giveaway!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "I know y'all must be dying to know more about our wide range of products, so I've written it all down in advance!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "First of all, let me introduce you to the best item in the whole shop — my lucky inflatable Puffer swimsuit! It can instantly inflate into a Puffer-themed life preserver, so if swimming isn't your forte, it's a must-have!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Next up, everyone's favorite — our surfboards! Whatever color, material, or design you want, we've got you covered! And even if we haven't got exactly what you're looking for, you can always customize your own!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "And it goes without saying, we've also got everything for water skiing, parasailing, beach volleyball, and more! There's too much to list out here, so feel free to come ask me in person!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "If you can't find me, don't panic!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Just head over to the beach volleyball and surfing areas to take a look around."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "If you really can't find me, don't sweat it! I've left a price list on this sign, so just leave your Mora on the counter if you're looking to buy something~"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Dear customers, I trust every single one of you!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "Just please, unless you're an experienced surfer, steer clear of our Sharky Surfboards!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "When it comes to speed, Sharky Surfboards blow regular ones out of the water, but they're much harder to control..."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "If you're not careful, you might end up crashing head-first into a reef!"

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Message
dialogues.text: "And if you're unlucky enough to pick up an injury, you'll waste precious vacation time laid up in bed recovering — definitely not a risk worth taking!"
